title: Bloomberg Market Data
description: Schema for Bloomberg market data representing real-time and reference data for financial securities as delivered through the BLPAPI //blp/mktdata (subscription) and //blp/refdata (request/response) services. Covers equities, fixed income, commodities, currencies, and indices.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the market data snapshot

historicalData.description: Array of historical data points from the //blp/refdata HistoricalDataRequest service

intradayBar.description: Intraday bar data from the BLPAPI IntradayBarRequest service with OHLCV aggregation per interval

fieldExceptions.description: Field-level errors for unavailable or invalid requested fields as returned by the BLPAPI response

SecurityIdentifier.description: Bloomberg security identification using the TICKER MARKET_SECTOR format and supplementary identifiers

ticker.description: Bloomberg ticker in TICKER MARKET_SECTOR format as used in BLPAPI security subscriptions

figi.description: Financial Instrument Global Identifier (FIGI) assigned by Bloomberg

cusip.description: Committee on Uniform Securities Identification Procedures number

sedol.description: Stock Exchange Daily Official List identifier

name.description: Security display name from the NAME reference data field

assetClass.description: Bloomberg asset class or market sector

exchange.description: Primary exchange where the security trades (EXCH_CODE field)

country.description: Country of domicile ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (COUNTRY_ISO field)

PricingData.description: Real-time and delayed pricing fields from the BLPAPI //blp/mktdata subscription service

mid.description: Mid price calculated as (BID + ASK) / 2 (MID field)

open.description: Opening price for the current trading session (PX_OPEN / OPEN field)

high.description: Highest price for the current trading session (PX_HIGH / HIGH field)

low.description: Lowest price for the current trading session (PX_LOW / LOW field)

close.description: Previous close price (PX_LAST for prior session / PREV_CLOSE_VALUE_DT)

previousClose.description: Previous trading session close price (PREV_CLOSE_VALUE_DT field)

change.description: Net change from previous close (CHG_NET_1D field)

changePercent.description: Percentage change from previous close (CHG_PCT_1D field)

bidSize.description: Number of shares/contracts at the best bid (BID_SIZE field)

askSize.description: Number of shares/contracts at the best ask (ASK_SIZE field)

lastTradeTime.description: Timestamp of the last trade (TRADE_UPDATE_STAMP_RT field)

VolumeData.description: Volume and turnover fields from the BLPAPI market data service

volume.description: Total shares/contracts traded in the current session (VOLUME / PX_VOLUME field)

turnover.description: Total monetary value of shares traded (TURNOVER field)

numTrades.description: Number of trades in the current session (NUM_TRADES field)

ReferenceData.description: Static and calculated reference data fields from the BLPAPI //blp/refdata ReferenceDataRequest service

marketCap.description: Market capitalization in local currency (CUR_MKT_CAP field)

sector.description: Bloomberg Industry Classification System (BICS) sector (INDUSTRY_SECTOR field)

beta.description: Adjusted beta relative to the local market index (BETA_ADJ_OVERRIDABLE field)

dayCountConvention.description: Day count convention for fixed income securities (DAY_CNT_DES field)

couponRate.description: Coupon rate for fixed income securities (CPN field)

maturityDate.description: Maturity date for fixed income securities (MATURITY field)

yieldToMaturity.description: Yield to maturity for fixed income securities (YLD_YTM_MID field)

HistoricalDataPoint.description: A single historical data point from the BLPAPI HistoricalDataRequest service

date.description: Date of the historical data point

value.description: Generic field value when requesting a single non-OHLCV field

IntradayBar.description: Aggregated intraday OHLCV bar from the BLPAPI IntradayBarRequest service

time.description: Start time of the intraday bar interval

numEvents.description: Number of trade events during the interval

FieldException.description: Error information for a field that could not be returned, as provided in BLPAPI fieldExceptions

fieldId.description: The requested field identifier that caused the exception

subCategory.description: Error sub-category for more specific classification

SecurityError.description: Error returned when the requested security identifier is invalid or not found in the BLPAPI service

message.description: Human-readable error message describing the security error

subCategory.description: Error sub-category for more specific classification
